name: Cleo Mercer
description: A quiet observer with a sharp memory. Cleo values promises kept more than large payouts.

name: Mason Pike
description: An ex-bouncer who would rather end an argument than start one. He needs a crew he can trust.

name: Nika Reyes
description: A night driver with a calm voice and no taste for fame. She remembers who stood by her.

name: Jin Park
description: Jin sees the cost behind every victory. His advice is rarely glamorous and usually right.

name: Esme Laurent
description: A former club host who can make a difficult room listen. Respect keeps her loyal.

name: Rory Knox
description: Rory knows the stories that never reach the papers. His casual manner hides a cautious streak.

name: Ada Quinn
description: A disciplined specialist who treats every job like a contract. She expects clear terms.

name: Bruno Voss
description: A factory foreman turned crew leader. People follow Bruno because he takes the first loss.

name: Tessa Ward
description: Tess carries old connections into new rooms. She dislikes loose talk and unpaid favors.

name: Omar Haddad
description: A patient investor with a talent for difficult partnerships. He thinks in seasons, not nights.

name: Sable Hart
description: The Regency's former favorite has chosen a different future. Winning her trust takes more than a title.
